title: Brian G NDE 6286
content: I was in Rio de Janeiro (Brazil) and at a 'cove-like' beach that (seemingly) was 'the' place for serious Brazilian surfers, in fact, this place was almost exclusively for surfers (particularly excellent surfers). This beach is known for large (sometimes 'huge') waves and treacherous rip currents. At the time, I was swimming and bodysurfing to the point of exhaustion, and decided to move away from the surfing area (big wave area) so as not to interfere with the surfers. Any surfer or beach-knowledgeable person that is aware of this situation can guess what happened; I was caught in a vicious rip-current. Three things combined to make this a 'death-inviting' circumstance: 1) vicious rip current; 2) exhaustion; 3) my lack of buoyancy (lots of muscle, dense bones, and little fat). I was drowning (I suppose I may have actually drowned, but since I am alive now, this becomes a semantic issue) and I was barely saved by a Brazilian surfer! Regarding my NDE: to be sure the 'other realm' is the 'other realm'! To me, there are some similarities between this realm and the other realm, yet there are some profound differences (Note: I am of course stating only my own experience and beliefs/interpretation about the other realm.) I will 'editorialize' about this at the end of my writing. The most evidentiary thing about my NDE was the out of body experience. I was able to 'see' the rescue and a 'close-up' view of the water and beach area and, most spectacularly, an extremely accurate hawk-eye view of the cove area. Noteworthy, after the fact, I was able to verify the amazing accuracy of my hawk-eye view of the cove via satellite photos, 'rial (plane or helicopter) photos, higher elevation (perch) photos, various boat vantage point photos and beach level photos. Wow! Notwithstanding, my out of body experience is only the most evidentiary thing to me, it is not the most important thing about my NDE. Moreover, I have no 'objective' evidence to prove my out of body experience or my NDE. Some of the characteristics of my NDE were, self-acceptance (believe me, this is NOT my natural state in this realm); unconditional positive regard; profound empathy; a preservation of life energy; fearlessness as to death; and, above all, freedom and a marvelous liberating feeling! Now for my 'editorializing', or contrasting to other NDE: Even though I felt a strong connection to 'wholesome' reality, I did not feel 'cosmic consciousness (a connection with 'everything'). Also, post my NDE, I have a very profound awareness that some evil is not merely a relative or quantitative occurrence, for some evil is a horrifically qualitative reality and some people are actually evil (for instance Joseph Stalin or Theodore Robert 'Ted' Bundy), they are not merely overly defensive or misguided.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He reported a “close-up” view of the water and beach area and an “extremely accurate hawk-eye view of the cove area.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning in a rip current while exhausted while swimming/bodysurfing at a cove-like beach in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil; rescued by a surfer.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Only an out-of-body component was described; no tunnel, beings, boundary, or return sequence was provided.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He emphasized veridical-looking “hawk-eye” perception of the cove and later compared it with satellite/aerial and other photos; he also reported strong self-acceptance, unconditional positive regard, profound empathy, preservation of life energy, fearlessness about death, and a liberating sense of freedom; he explicitly noted he did not experience “cosmic consciousness” and afterward felt some evil is qualitatively real (e.g., Stalin, Ted Bundy).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “to be sure the 'other realm' is the 'other realm'!”; “an extremely accurate hawk-eye view of the cove area.”; “I did not feel 'cosmic consciousness (a connection with 'everything').”
